Based on the customer review for New Car Rental in London, the support address and instructions for child-seat requests are provided directly in the review text:

> *"Child-seat requests go to support@newcarrental.co.uk."*

This means that to inquire about or reserve a child seat, you should contact them at **support@newcarrental.co.uk**. The review does not specify availability or pricing, but it clearly indicates the correct support channel for such requests.
